capabilities: Render the vault as a 3D graph
Highlight a note's neighbors on focus
Show or hide folders and tags
disambiguation: Not a space-themed skin; it is an interactive 3D graph of the vault's links and folders.
extras: Runs fully locally with no network requests or telemetry; interface supports English and French; rendering pauses when the view is hidden to save battery.
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph view is flat and does not show how notes cluster by folder.
summary: 3D graph view of the vault that colors nodes by top-level folder, with glow, starfield, search, and neighbor highlighting.
